post.summary: Somebody asked for a keypoint in simpler words.
post.description: Counts against the CONTENT, weekly — nothing about the reader is written. A keypoint people keep asking to have re-explained is a keypoint that needs rewriting, and that queue is the whole purpose.

post.summary: Turn a spoken turn into the reader's own words.
post.description: The audio is never stored — it exists for the length of this request. The text comes back into the composer for the reader to edit before sending, so a bad transcription is theirs to fix rather than something filed under their name. A failure answers with an empty string rather than an error.

enabled.description: Kill switch. False stops the popup without an app release, and lets a campaign be staged before going live
